description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


Fix newer GPT-5 models being sent an unsupported parameter

• Fixed newer GPT-5 models (such as gpt-5.0) being sent a reasoning effort setting they no longer support, which could make requests fail (#1853)
• Refreshed the built-in fallback model list, shown when the model list cannot be fetched from the API, to lead with the GPT-5 series instead of GPT-4 models
